cues.text: Monsieur LaPadite
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: I regret to inform you I've exhausted the extent of my French.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: To continue to speak it so inadequately would only serve to embarrass me.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: However, I've been led to believe you speak English quite well.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: Yes.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: Well, it just so happens, I do as well. This being your house
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: I ask your permission to switch to English
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: for the remainder of the conversation.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: But the meaning of your visit,
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: pleasant though it is, is mysterious to me.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: The Germans looked through my house nine months ago for hiding Jews
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: and found nothing.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: I'm aware of that.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: I've read the reports of this area.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: But like any enterprise, when under new management,
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: there is always a slight duplication of efforts,
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: most of it being a complete waste of time, but needs to be done nevertheless.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: I just have a few questions, monsieur LaPadite.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: If you can assist me with answers,
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: my department can close the file on your family.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: The feature that makes me such an effective hunter of the Jews is,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: as opposed to most German soldiers,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Now, if one were to determine what attribute the German people share with a beast,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: But if one were to determine what attributes the Jews share with a beast,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: But where our conclusions differ,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: is I don't consider the comparison an insult.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Consider for a moment the world a rat lives in.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: It's a hostile world, indeed.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: If a rat were to scamper through your front door, right now,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: would you greet it with hostility?
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: I suppose I would.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Has a rat ever done anything to you to create this animosity you feel toward them?
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Rats spread disease. They bite people.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Rats were the cause of the bubonic plague, but that's some time ago.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: I propose to you any disease a rat could spread,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: a squirrel could equally carry.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Would you agree?
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Yet, I assume you don't share the same animosity with squirrels
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: - that you do with rats, do you? - No.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: Yet, they're both rodents, are they not?
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: And except for the tail, they even rather look alike, don't they?
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: It's an interesting thought, Herr Colonel.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: However interesting as the thought may be,
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: it makes not one bit of difference to how you feel.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: If a rat were to walk in here, right now, as I'm talking
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: would you greet it with a saucer of your delicious milk?
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: of a house suspected of hiding Jews.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: However, the reason the Führer has brought me off my Alps in Austria
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: and placed me in French cow country today is because it does occur to me.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: once they abandon dignity.
cues.method: Movie VTT offset estimate; locally adjusted where checked

cues.text: And if there are any irregularities to be found, rest assured they will be.

cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: Yes.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.text: Yes.
cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.

cues.method: Official English VTT translated/retimed by inspected native clip offset and local ASR; not phoneme-exact.
